title: Open Water Swim · 1000 m
notes:
Intensity: Steady/Endurance

Open water swim all in Z2. Take as many rests as you want. This first swim is just to get used to the environment. We'll do some faster sections from next week onwards, but just take it easy today. Swim safe in open water: always go with a buddy and wear a bright cap. Practice sighting to stay on course.
